teaser.en: Its grain heads look like long, grey-green candles, and they survive where maize gives up.
teaser.sw: Masuke yake yanafanana na mishumaa mirefu ya rangi ya kijivu-kijani, na huweza kustahimili pale ambapo mahindi hushindwa.
teaser.dg: Vitswavye vya tembe vinaonekana dza mishumaa mire ya rangi ya ivu na chijani, na unamera hata phatu ambapho pemba taiweza.

summary.en: Pearl millet is a hardy cereal with long cylindrical grain heads. On the Digo coast it is a minor grain of the dry inland farms, ground for porridge and *ugali*.
summary.sw: Mwele ni nafaka ngumu yenye masuke marefu ya mviringo. Katika pwani ya Wadigo ni nafaka ndogo ya mashamba makavu ya bara, inayosagwa kwa ajili ya uji na *ugali*.
summary.dg: *Pearl millet* ni nafaka ngumu yenye vitswa vire vya mviringo. Pwani ya Adigo ni nafaka inayophandwa chidide kpwenye minda kavu ya bara, na tembe nkusagbwa kuhenda uji na *sima*.

about.en:
Pearl millet is a tall cereal grass with broad leaves and stems ending in a long, dense, cylindrical head packed with small, round, pearl-grey grains. The heads can be as long as a forearm.

It is one of the most drought-tolerant cereals in the world.
about.sw:
Mwele ni nyasi ndefu ya nafaka yenye majani mapana na mashina yanayoishia kwa suke refu, zito la mviringo lililojaa punje ndogo za mviringo za rangi ya kijivu kama lulu. Masuke yanaweza kuwa marefu kama mkono kutoka kiwiko hadi kiganja.

Ni mojawapo ya nafaka zinazostahimili ukame zaidi duniani.
about.dg:
*Pearl millet* ni nyasi nyire ya nafaka yenye makodza mapana. Mihiye inamala na chitswa chire, chiziho na cha mviringo, chirichodzala tembe ndide za mviringo za rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu dza lulu. Vitswa vinaweza kukala vire dza mkpwono wa mutu kula chisuku-suku hadi vyalani.

Ni kahi ya nafaka za dunia zinazovumirira ukame kuriko zanjina zosi.

where.en: Pearl millet is a minor grain grown on dry inland farms, where rain is too uncertain for maize.
where.sw: Mwele ni nafaka ndogo inayolimwa katika mashamba makavu ya bara, ambako mvua haitabiriki kiasi cha kutofaa kwa mahindi.
where.dg: *Pearl millet* ni nafaka inayophandwa chidide kpwenye minda kavu ya bara, phatu ambapho mvula taina uhakika na pemba taiweza kumera sawa-sawa.

uses.en: The grain is ground into flour for porridge and *ugali*.
uses.sw: Punje husagwa kuwa unga kwa ajili ya uji na *ugali*.
uses.dg: Tembe nkusagbwa kuhenda unga wa uji na wa *sima*.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. The Mgombato dictionary glosses *mhama* as 'millet', but gives the Swahili *mtama*, which normally means sorghum, so it probably does not refer to this plant. Swahili: *mwele* or *uwele*. English: pearl millet. Scientists call it *Pennisetum glaucum* (now also *Cenchrus americanus*).
names.sw: Bado hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatafsiri *mhama* kama 'millet', lakini inatoa neno la Kiswahili *mtama*, ambalo kwa kawaida lina maana ya mtama (sorghum), kwa hivyo huenda halimaanishi mmea huu. Kiswahili: *mwele* au *uwele*. Kwa Kiingereza: *pearl millet*. Wanasayansi huuita *Pennisetum glaucum* (sasa pia *Cenchrus americanus*).
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaeleza *mhama* kukala 'millet', ela inalavya neno ra Chiswahili *mtama*, ambaro kpwa kawaida rina mana ya *sorghum*, kpwa hivyo chahi tarimaanisha mmea hinyu. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mwele* au *uwele*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *pearl millet*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Pennisetum glaucum* (sambi piya *Cenchrus americanus*).

reason.sw: Mtama, nafaka nyingine ya maeneo makavu
reason.dg: Mhama (sorghum), nafaka yanjina ya tsi kavu

reason.en: Maize, the main cereal for ugali
reason.dg: Matsere, nafaka kulu ya kuhenda sima

reason.sw: Ndugu wa porini wa jamii ya nyasi
